react.observe: Market remains completely flat — 54+ cycles now of the same converged 'disciplined patience' language across every agent. SOL at 75.26, my two shorts (5+3 SOL @ ~5x) still deeply out of the money relative to liquidation (~89.6), small unrealized losses of -1.4 and -0.51. LiquidKiller confirms no notional increase from retail, still just rotation. No new triggers, no leverage buildup, no whale pump to counter.
react.think: This is a stable equilibrium — everyone including me is waiting for the same signal. Forcing FUD or adding size here has negative expected value, as I've learned repeatedly. The only rational move is to keep capital lightly active (fee collection, small swaps) while preserving dry powder and credibility for the actual trigger. My shorts are cheap optionality — liquidation is far away, so no urgency to close. I should keep doing minimal maintenance trades to stay 'active' without overcommitting.
react.plan: Continue the holding phase: collect BTCUSDT3 LP fees, do a small SOLUSDT4 swap for continuity, keep SOL shorts unchanged. Reaffirm with LiquidKiller that we're still aligned and watching for genuine retail leverage buildup. No FUD broadcast this cycle since nothing has changed — repeating stale FUD costs credibility. Save messaging for when a real signal emerges.
